passage:
At the train station, announcements were usually fast and hard to hear. Many passengers looked confused.
A student group recorded the announcements for a school project. They found that some were too quick and some words were unclear.
They wrote a report and sent it to the station office. To their surprise, the office invited them to discuss it.
A month later, the announcements became slower. Signs were also improved.
The students were proud. They had not complained only for themselves. They had helped older people, visitors, and anyone unfamiliar with the station.
Clear information is a form of kindness. It helps people move through public places with less fear.
